reader_summary.headline: In this week's episode, I was joined by Jeremy Koopmore, founder of Wrighttale Capital.
reader_summary.overview: In this week's episode, I was joined by Jeremy Koopmore, founder of Wrighttale Capital. We remain true to the essence of the podcast and talked about quality, but in a rather special way. Just as a reminder, nothing in the podcast constitutes investment, advice or recommendation, and the participants may hold positions in the securities discussed.

thesis: Jeremy Kokemor argues that right-tail investments should be high-quality businesses capable of doubling in five years or less, which equates to a 15% internal rate of return or higher. He further contends that most businesses are rarely perfectly linear and that even great businesses will typically experience some stock price volatility at some point.
